# Campus Manitoba PressbooksEDU Network

> A Manitoba-based open educational resources platform providing freely accessible, adaptable textbooks and educational materials for post-secondary institutions.

Campus Manitoba PressbooksEDU Network is a collaborative initiative leveraging Pressbooks technology to create and distribute open educational resources across Manitoba's post-secondary institutions. The platform hosts curated collections of OER materials, specialized guides, and digital publishing tools designed to reduce textbook costs and support inclusive, culturally-informed education.

## Core Platform

- [Campus Manitoba PressbooksEDU Network](https://pressbooks.openedmb.ca): Homepage for Campus Manitoba PressbooksEDU Network OER platform
- [About Campus Manitoba PressbooksEDU Network](https://pressbooks.openedmb.ca/about): Information about Campus Manitoba PressbooksEDU Network initiative
- [Catalogue](https://pressbooks.openedmb.ca/catalog): Searchable catalog of open educational resources and textbooks

## Educational Resources & Guides

- [Pulling Together: Manitoba Foundations Guide (Brandon Edition)](https://pressbooks.openedmb.ca/pullingtogethermanitoba): Indigenous education guide for post-secondary foundations
- [Generative Artificial Intelligence: Practical Uses in Education](https://pressbooks.openedmb.ca/aiineducation): Practical guide for implementing generative AI in education
- [Copyright Toolkit for Manitoba Post-Secondary Institutions](https://pressbooks.openedmb.ca/postsecondarycopyright): Copyright toolkit and fair-dealing guide for Manitoba institutions
